entities.title: UI
entities.summary: Everything the player sees and hears: one painter per engine screen, the extras, the strings, the pixel art, the sound motifs, the name entry and the sound overlay.
entities.purpose: Draws each engine Screen on a ZXScreen, cell for cell from docs/UI-DESIGN.md, and says how it is presented: the keypad offer, how long it holds before it reads a key, whether it moves on by itself, its sound, its animation steps and its screen-reader text. Every player-facing string is in text.ts and every melody in sounds.ts, written in the art bible's notation.
boundaries: Decides nothing about the game: the engine does.
Waits for no key and keeps no time itself: src/main.ts presents what a painter returns.
